Dave Main continued his run of successes by securing third place, while Len Herbert ran well to be sixth. The team championship resulted in an easy win for the "Bels," and we also secured the "Oddling-Smee" Cup, which is awarded to the first Surrey club finishing its complete team of 12 men.

We were wondering what had happened to Tom Carter, but he soon came along and although not running in his usual form, he was quite well up considering the class of the field. Dave Main was with Tom and Geoff. Pearson, Tom Clinton and Dick Tobin were all going strong.
However, bearing in mind the absence of Dave Main and Geoff. Pearson, and the mishap to Tom Carter, we can be quite satisfied with our lads' performances.
